title: Validation evidence item
description: One piece of cited evidence behind a validation record (EE-026), shared by every validation sub-score. schema/check-validation.mjs grades each item from its kind, audience, sample, specificity and age (adapted from GRADE), and grades the record from its items. A claim with no evidence grades very low.

kind.description: behavior: what people did (retention, payments, repeat use, money or time already spent on workarounds); commitment: what they put at stake (deposit, pre-order, letter of intent, time booked); stated: what they said when asked (interview, survey); desk-research: published data or reports; opinion: unprompted praise, advice or compliments

summary.description: What the evidence shows, specific enough to check

supports.description: false when the evidence contradicts the claim

source.description: Where to see it: a URL with the date it was checked, or a file relative to the venture folder (interview notes, a data export), or both

audience.description: Whether the people behind it are the venture's target segment for this claim (for pricing, the buyer)

specificity.description: specific: past facts, numbers, named instances; general: hypotheticals, generalities, opinions about the future (The Mom Test)
